query.esql:
FROM logs-*
| WHERE process.ai_agent.email IS NOT NULL AND process.ai_agent.email LIKE "*@*" AND event.module == "endpoint"
| DISSECT process.ai_agent.email "%{?user}@%{email_domain}"
| STATS email_count = COUNT_DISTINCT(process.ai_agent.email) BY email_domain
| SORT email_count DESC

FROM logs-*
| WHERE process.ai_agent.email IS NOT NULL AND process.ai_agent.email LIKE "*@*" AND event.module == "endpoint"
| DISSECT process.ai_agent.email "%{?user}@%{email_domain}"
| STATS email_count = COUNT_DISTINCT(process.ai_agent.email) BY email_domain
| SORT email_count DESC

FROM logs-*
| WHERE process.ai_agent.name IS NOT NULL
    AND event.module == "endpoint" 
    AND event.dataset == "endpoint.events.network" 
    AND dns.question.name IS NOT NULL
| REGISTERED_DOMAIN rd = dns.question.name
| EVAL domain = COALESCE(rd.registered_domain, dns.question.name)
| STATS lookup_count = COUNT(domain), 
        hostnames_array = VALUES(dns.question.name) BY domain
| EVAL full_domains = MV_CONCAT(hostnames_array, ", ")
| KEEP domain, lookup_count, full_domains
| SORT lookup_count DESC
| LIMIT 200
